Asset inventory: record the MAC address of every server NIC.

getmac /v gives the connection name next to the address, for example

Connection Name Network Adapter Physical Address    Transport Name
=============== =============== =================== ==========================================================
Ethernet        Intel(R) Ethern 00-00-5E-00-53-10   \Device\Tcpip_{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010}

Copy the Physical Address column into the inventory sheet.
